risks.title: Unfavorable Economic Conditions
risks.score_rationale: Listed first in economic and operational risks. Language is strong (adversely affected, could continue to adversely affect) and covers numerous macroeconomic factors. This risk is weighted by its direct impact on sales and profits.

risks.title: Supply Chain Disruptions
risks.score_rationale: Strongly emphasized in economic and operational risks with terms such as disruption and/or shortages and adversely affected. Risk is exacerbated by dependence on single suppliers and global events. It is weighted by its direct impact on production and product availability.

risks.title: Product Innovation Dependency
risks.score_rationale: Presented as a key growth factor (significant portion of our net sales) but with clear failure risk (may not be able to enhance, may not receive market acceptance). Language intensity is moderate.

risks.title: Climate Change and Weather Impact
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in economic and operational risks with growing emphasis (exacerbated by global climate change, increased frequency and intensity). Language is strong (chronic and acute physical risks, adversely impact). This risk is weighted by its potential impact on operations and demand.

risks.title: Intense Competition
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned as intense competition in economic and operational risks, with direct impact on business and operating results. Language is direct and the risk is a constant in this sector.

risks.title: Acquisition and Partnership Risks
risks.score_rationale: Identified in strategic risks, with specific mention of recent activities (Tornado Infrastructure Equipment). Language indicates clear risk (involve risk and may prove to be unsuccessful).

risks.title: Legal and Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: Presented in legal, regulatory and compliance risks, covering intellectual property protection and general regulatory compliance (subject to extensive regulation). Language is direct.

ai_positioning.summary: TTC does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
